phases.title: Build skeleton
phases.goal: a Norm-clean `coders/` that builds `codexion` with the deliverable Makefile (cc -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread, NAME/all/clean/fclean/re, no relink), a `main.h` with the base types and a minimal `main.c`

phases.title: Argument parsing and validation
phases.goal: parse and validate the 8 arguments into a config with reusable primitives (one shared trim of surrounding whitespace for numbers, digits only, overflow-safe up to INT_MAX, per-field minimums, scheduler exactly fifo/edf); any invalid input prints a specific error and the usage to stderr and exits non-zero before allocating or starting threads

phases.title: Time and serialized logging
phases.goal: millisecond clock relative to the simulation start (gettimeofday), a stop-aware sliced sleep, and a mutex-serialized logger that prints the five subject state lines and nothing after the stop except the burnout line

phases.title: Priority queue
phases.goal: a hand-written binary min-heap of dongle requests ordered by key then arrival ticket, supporting the fifo key (arrival ticket) and the edf key (last_compile_start + time_to_burnout)

phases.title: Simulation state init and teardown
phases.goal: build the `t_sim` (coders, dongles with mutex/cond/heap, stop and log mutexes, seat-to-dongle mapping with 1 dongle for 1 coder) and tear it down completely, cleaning up partial initialisation on any malloc or pthread init failure without leaks

phases.title: Dongle arbitration
phases.goal: atomic two-dongle acquisition (a coder takes both only when it is the head of both dongle heaps and both are available with cooldown elapsed, mutexes locked lower-index first), release with cooldown, pthread_cond_timedwait waits with no busy-wait and wake-all on stop, with arbiter-level tests (head-of-both rule, fifo/edf ordering, cooldown, stop wake-up) as evidence for the PLAN.md progress argument

phases.title: Coder thread
phases.goal: the coder routine loops take dongles, compiling, release, debugging, refactoring with correct logs, updates last_compile_start and compile_count under its own mutex, and exits promptly on stop (single coder takes its only dongle and waits to burn out)

phases.title: Monitor thread
phases.goal: a separate monitor thread that detects a burnout and logs it within 10 ms, or detects that every coder reached number_of_compiles_required, then sets stop and wakes all waiting threads

phases.title: Simulation lifecycle
phases.goal: main wires parse, init, start the coder and monitor threads, join and teardown end to end, with clean shutdown on pthread_create failure and the edge cases (1 coder, zero compiles required) behaving as specified

phases.title: Hardening and README
phases.goal: prove the whole program against the subject with full-binary simulation tests (fifo/edf ordering, cooldown, no burnout under edf at and above the PLAN.md viability boundary including the N = 6 interleaved case, typical evaluation runs, valgrind leak-free, TSan race-free, Norm-clean) and complete the README with its mandatory sections, real outputs and didactic tone
